title: Galactic Republic Product-Origin Completeness Audit
rulesBaseline: AMG final Armada update: Rules Reference 1.6.0 / Errata 5.5, January 10, 2025

scope.included: Unique database designs originating in the four Galactic Republic retail products already installed by Milestones 1.1–1.4.
scope.excluded: Neutral upgrades from older non-Republic products that are merely legal for Republic fleets. Those belong to a later legality/compatibility audit.
